geometry.basis: Author-declared air+large-paper-baffle condition3. These six originals were absent from this worker retained acquisition/source scan before freeze. Reuse unchanged small-baffle method and all alternatives, but derive every coefficient only from these original condition3 training courses. No condition2 damping reused. Delta remains empirical, not physical length correction. All three receiving repetitions are selected now, no replacement or outcome tuning.

fit.meaning: Same compact weak operator on original training positions, shared empirical −A/(L+delta) sine coefficient, independent course damping. Supplied starts/rates never fit this relation. Window residual is not forward prediction error, physical geometry calibration or identification. Every offered relation retained; no receiving input.
